newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Ruling, main opposition parties expected to resume negotiations over constutitional amendments.
Xinhua chief in Hong Kong says it will be easier for Taiwan people to visit Hong Kong after colony's handover to China.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan may allow mainland-funded vessels to sail to island.
Two main parties, their earlier understanding in jeopardy, continue to wrangle over constitutional amendments.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says provincial governor James Soong has expressed support for eventual dissolving of provincial government.
President Lee shows strong resolve in seeking to pass constitutional amendments.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Government and military personnel to receive three percent salary raise starting July.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government to loosen cap on bank investment in stock market.
Base land tax to be raised.
